verses.gurmukhi: ਲਤਾਂ ਹੇਠਿ ਲਤਾੜੀਐ ਘਾਹੁ ਨ ਕਢੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: lataa(n) heTh lataaReeaai ghaahu na kaddai saahu vichaaraa|

en.bdb: Grass is trampled under feet yet the poor thing never complains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਸੁ ਦੇ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਗਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: goras dhe khaR khai kai gai gareebee paraupakaaraa|

en.bdb: The cow while eating grass remains altruist and gives milk to the poor.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਜਮਾਈਐ ਦਈਅਹੁ ਮਖਣੁ ਛਾਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhudhahu dhahee jamaieeaai dhieeahu makhan chhaeh piaaraa|

en.bdb: From milk is made curd and then from curd butter and delicious butter-milk etc are prepared.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਿਅ ਤੇ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਢੰਗ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: ghia te hovan hom jag dda(n)g suaarath chaj achaaraa|

en.bdb: With that butter (ghee) homs, yajnas and other social and religious rituals are performed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਧੀਰਜਿ ਵਹੈ ਸਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dharam dhaul paragaT hoi dheeraj vahai sahai sir bhaaraa|

en.bdb: Dharma in the form of mythological bull patiently bears and burden of the earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਉ ਜਣੇਦਿਆਂ ਚਹੁ ਚਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਗ ਹਜਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik ik jaau janedhiaa(n) chahu chakaa vich vag hajaaraa|

en.bdb: Each calf produces thousands of calves in all lands.
One blade of grass has infinite extension i.e.the humility becomes base of the whole world.
